items.text:
Rude staff
And force you to have a minimum spend on your card, even when adding to an existing £30 + order.

The food was inedible. Pork fried rice was hard to chew, lo mein was tasteless, spring rolls were greasy and awful tasting, I had to spit out the general tsp chicken, it was so dry and hard I couldn’t break it down, never again
 my stomach aches

Amazing food and great service!

Staff work so hard, very friendly and great service.

Five star service from Kimberly the hardworking lady who served us tonight. Very attentive and patient, constantly running around to make sure the customers need were met. Multi-tasking both takeaway & table service. She is definitely an asset to her family restaurant.

Great food and although the food was a bit slow due to them being really busy, they were apologetic and ensured we had drinks. So can’t fault the service and friendly atmosphere. The banana fritters were amazing and will definitely be back next time we are over. Thank you

Fantastic food, extremely friendly, nothings to much trouble highly recommended

Fully recommend eating in or getting a takeaway from this Chinese restaurant. Having Coeliac disease, I find it hard to find restaurants that can accommodate my allergies. The wonderful staff at The Dragon have a lot of knowledge about which options on the menu I can and cannot eat and makes the experience so enjoyable. The food is incredibly tasty and affordable too. Very happy customer!

just had a meal for 5 people booked our table the service was slow and that was the best part of the night. The portions were small and overpriced chicken balls were overcooked and again very small portions. would not recommend this place to anyone.

The perfect restaurant. Owners and staff are fabulous. A must eat place.

Dear valued customer,

We are pleased to share our updated menu with revised prices. Please note that the new prices will take effect from today. Thank you for your continued support. 🐲❤️

Dear valued customers,
Due to staff shortage, our service may be slower than usual, particularly during peak hours. We understand this may disappoint some of you, we truly regret that we are unable to provide our usual speed of service during these busy periods.
We would like to kindly ask for your patience and understanding as our team does its very best to serve everyone as quickly and efficiently as possible. Please rest assured that we are doing everything we can to minimize delays and continuing to provide you with quality of food and service that you deserve.
Thank you for your continued support, patience and understanding, we sincerely appreciate each and every of you.
 See less
